name: When a circuit will not cast

pages.title: When a circuit will not cast
pages.text: Check in order: affordable input, a path to output, both AND inputs, switch state and signal direction, reachable storage threshold, and enough mana for the chosen volume.
Then check wand wear, cooldown, preparation, explicit child triggers and board fit. With a parameter editor open, Enter saves that parameter first; press Enter again to save the circuit.
